_about: Every section the website's facility and company pages can print, and where the mobile app (kidsoverprofits/kids-over-profits-mobile) shows it. scripts/test-app-parity.php fails when a template prints a section not listed here, or when a listed app section is missing from the app's section list (src/components/facility/model.ts presentSections(), src/components/operator/model.ts sectionsOf()). "app": the app's section id. "todo": not in the app yet, with what porting it needs; each todo is an open item in docs/plan/4.8-app.md. "skip": never in the app, with the reason. Sections made by helpers outside the templates ("helper") are listed by hand: the test cannot see them.
